messages:
emma: hey team, just opened my first PR to tidy a couple util funcs. quick Qs: branch prefix you prefer, commit msg style, should i run any special integration tests locally, and who to ping for reviews?
ryan: welcome emma! branch: refactor/<short-topic> or feat/<short-topic> if adding behavior. keep it succinct.
aj: commit message: One-line present-tense summary (e.g., "Refactor: collapse duplicate utils"). Blank line then details if needed. Squash for small PRs.
olivia: reviewers: check /.github/CODEOWNERS for auto requests. if you touch runtime/docker/k8s, ping me or @eng-runtime. For public API changes add @platform-api.
ci-bot: Note: integration jobs run in CI for changes touching deps or dockerfiles.
emma: how strict about changelog?
ryan: only add a CHANGELOG entry for user-facing changes or bug fixes. internal refactors no.
emma: any tests i should run locally besides unit tests?
aj: run unit tests + lint: "pre-commit run --all-files" and "pytest -q". if you touched infra, run integration: "scripts/run-integ.sh".
emma: cool. can i self-merge after approval?
olivia: generally no unless you're a CODEOWNER for affected files. need at least one approval and green CI. docs-only tiny fixes sometimes allow a single reviewer.
emma: awesome, thanks all. i'll squash, add checklist in PR body, and ping CODEOWNERS + @olivia if needed.
ryan: welcome aboard! ping for a 10-min repo tour if you want.
